regime_context: Hong Kong themes show a narrow eligible leadership set: only 4 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Conglomerates). Banks lead with durability_bar 0.67 but the theme is unscorable and breadth is moderate (0.69); Energy is the confirmed second with stronger trend tag and breadth 0.8. China Tech & Internet and China Platform Megacaps are the only scorable names and both sit ineligible at negative ranks.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks sit at rank 1, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with durability_bar 0.67 and breadth 0.69 — leadership is broad enough to be non-idiosyncratic, though the theme is unscorable. The lean is a trend-following view on the ONE validated leg: the gate says this theme is in an absolute uptrend, so exposure survives a shake-out. No crowding flag. The thesis is a conditional: IF banks maintain the trend gate, they deserve a long bias; the detector does not forecast their return.
theses.dissent: Banks are H-shares and HK locals with a 'mixed' hurst tag and no scorable proxy — a mixed trend can chop sideways, and the rank-IC of relative momentum is near zero, so the leadership may simply reflect capital rotation out of Tech rather than genuine bank fundamentals.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) falls below its absolute-trend gate (eligible flips to false) before the 30-day check-by date.
